emails.verification: Published in plaintext on Overview Music's official first-party site. The address has valid syntax and exactly matches the overviewmusic.co.uk label domain. It is not described as a dedicated demo mailbox and is therefore limited to an asset-free routing inquiry.

businessContact.emailStatus: source-verified public business mailbox; not verified as a direct demo-delivery destination
businessContact.verification: Verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax, exact domain alignment, business context and current official-site availability. No address was guessed or obtained from a third-party directory. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: No dedicated demo form or direct demo-delivery policy was identified. A human must obtain explicit instructions from the label before sending any music or personal data.

activityVerification.evidence: Overview Music's official site was live and functional, exposed a populated commercial release catalogue and artist, events and radio/podcast sections, promoted Overview100, and offered current digital releases and label merchandise through its first-party storefront.

genreFitEvidence: The official catalogue lists releases by Klinical, Molecular, Emperor, Trex, Skylark, Creatures and Wingz.
The label's catalogue and artist presentation are centred on drum-and-bass and adjacent electronic bass music.
Only a MarcsMusic release with a strong drum-and-bass or bass-music fit should be considered after the label confirms that demos are open.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: Overview Music is active and publishes a source-verified business mailbox, but it does not publicly authorize direct unsolicited-demo delivery or publish current format, eligibility, rights, content or AI-origin rules. Human review is required for a strictly asset-free inquiry and for every later delivery decision.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete active pull-request patch resource and repository code search were checked for Overview Music, overviewmusic.co.uk and info@overviewmusic.co.uk. No prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The public label mailbox is stored once as one asset-free inquiry opportunity. The storefront, newsletter, social accounts, artist pages, events and radio/podcast links are excluded as duplicate or unauthorized delivery routes.

notes: One new free-first Overview Music routing opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The public business mailbox was source-verified, but it was not treated as authorization to send a demo. No email, music, form or payment action occurred.
